Subject: FW: PraxisBio SLA claim - calc request

Lauren / Aditya — forwarding Praxis' claim. I ran the initial window; uptime export attached. I also put together a conservative credit calc in the attached workbook (credit_calc_praxisbio_May14.xlsx). Summary below: 

Summary of inputs (from our systems):
- Customer committed monthly spend (PX-67B): $42,000/month
- Incident window affecting committed throughput: 01:36:45–02:15:10 UTC = 38.42 minutes
- Total seconds in month used for SLA: 2,678,400 (30-day month baseline for committed pool)
- Downtime percentage = 38.42 minutes / (30 days * 24 * 60) = 0.0895%

SLA clause: 99.95% uptime => eligible if monthly availability below 99.95%
- Calculated availability this month (full detailed calc in workbook): 99.9105% => breach of 0.0395%
- Per SLA remedy: service offset equals proportional fraction of monthly committed fees for the breached percentage (some language allows minimum credit tiers; workbook uses clause B.3).

Proposed credit (conservative): $42,000 * 0.000395 = $16.59 -> rounding to nearest dollar rules gives $17 credit.

Notes / asks:
- This looks like a small dollar amount due to very low downtime as fraction of month. Sales typically offers either: 1) apply the exact prorated offset on next monthly invoice, or 2) offer a goodwill credit (rounded to a minimum visible amount) to simplify accounting (we've done $250 minimum in prior cases).
- Praxis is a strategic account; recommend the $250 goodwill credit to preserve relationship and avoid churn risk. If agreed, Finance will need an invoice/credit memo to apply and Legal to sign the remedy memo (standard).

Attachments: credit_calc_praxisbio_May14.xlsx (excel)

Connor
